rules.sentence: Patients with pulmonary obstruction due to pulmonary stenosis (PS) or atresia exhibit reduced pulmonary venous return, resulting in diminished systemic arterial oxygen saturation and the development of cyanosis.

The classification system for tricuspid atresia offers a comprehensive framework for categorizing a specific cardiac lesion based on key factors, including the relationship of the great arteries, the presence of a VSD, and the degree of pulmonary obstruction.[1][6][7]
